describes: Modal-head phrases the prose grammar's modal_head production recognises, each mapped to one of the three canonical lexemes (shall/must/may) the truth table (_NEGATED_MODAL in deontic.prose_grammar) dispatches on. A data table, not a regex: the recursive-descent parser matches a phrase's words at a token position; it does not compile or search a pattern. Multi-word phrases are tried longest-first at each position. English only (Phase 1 scope).
